"""Explicitly synthetic appointment projections using the actual authority roster.

These fixtures establish a ready packet only for exercising the admitted-outcome
projection. They do not establish readiness or approval for any supplied file.
No real batch is processed and no output artifact is written.
"""

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

from credentialing.documents import parse_document
from credentialing.engine import ELEMENTS, check_decision, decision_conditions, project
from credentialing.io import load_sources
from credentialing.policy import registry


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
EXECUTIVE = "Executive Committee of the Medical Staff"
GOVERNING = "Governing Body"


class ActivationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.reg = registry(load_sources(ROOT / "sources"))

    def setUp(self):
        self.app = {"application_id": "SYNTHETIC-ACTIVATION-APP", "revision": "1",
                    "received_date": "2026-01-01", "first_name": "Test", "middle_name": "", "last_name": "Applicant"}
        self.assessed = {"intake": {"missing": [], "notices": []}, "packet_presentable": True,
                         "elements": {element: "resolved" for element in ELEMENTS}, "action_queue": [],
                         "licensure": {"wa": None},
                         "privileges": {"requested": ["PRIV-FM", "PRIV-IM"], "supported": ["PRIV-FM", "PRIV-IM"]}}
        self.recommendation = self.decision(decision_id="SYNTHETIC-MEC-001", body=EXECUTIVE,
                                            outcome="recommended", when="2026-04-01", privileges="PRIV-FM; PRIV-IM")
        self.assertTrue(self.recommendation["admitted"], self.recommendation["failures"])

    def decision(self, *, decision_id="SYNTHETIC-GB-001", body=GOVERNING, outcome="approved", when="2026-04-10",
                 privileges="PRIV-FM", effective="", reason="", conditions=(), supersedes="", prior=None, signatory=None):
        role = next(row for row in self.reg["roles"] if row["role"] == f"Chair, {body}")
        name = signatory or role["name"]
        fields = {"Decision ID": decision_id, "Body": body, "Signatory": name, "Role": role["role"],
                  "Application": self.app["application_id"], "Revision": self.app["revision"], "Decision date": when,
                  "Outcome": outcome, "Privileges": privileges, "Criteria version": self.reg["criteria_version"],
                  "Reason": reason, "Effective date": effective, "Supersedes": supersedes}
        text = "# Synthetic committee fixture\n\n" + "\n".join(f"**{key}:** {value}  " for key, value in fields.items())
        if conditions:
            text += "\n\n## Conditions\n" + "\n".join("- " + condition for condition in conditions)
        text += f"\n\nSigned: {name}, {role['role']}, {when}.\n"
        doc = parse_document("synthetic/" + decision_id + ".md", text,
                             {"application_id": self.app["application_id"], "date": when, "direction": "inbound"})
        if prior is None:
            prior = [] if body == EXECUTIVE else [self.recommendation]
        failures = check_decision(doc, self.app, self.assessed, self.reg, prior)
        return {"fields": doc["fields"], "source": doc["path"], "admitted": not failures,
                "failures": failures, "conditions": decision_conditions(doc)[0]}

    def project(self, decision, *, as_of="2026-04-20", prior=None):
        decisions = [self.recommendation, *(prior or []), decision]
        return project(self.app, self.assessed, decisions, [], self.reg, as_of)

    def test_admitted_approval_activates_only_granted_subset_on_effective_day(self):
        approval = self.decision(effective="2026-05-01")
        self.assertTrue(approval["admitted"], approval["failures"])
        before = self.project(approval, as_of="2026-04-30")
        self.assertEqual(before["status"], "approved-not-yet-effective")
        self.assertEqual(before["approval_decision_id"], "SYNTHETIC-GB-001")
        self.assertEqual(before["activation"], {"active_at_export": False, "effective_date": "2026-05-01",
                                              "cycle_end": "2027-04-30", "privileges": ["PRIV-FM"]})
        active = self.project(approval, as_of="2026-05-01")
        self.assertEqual(active["status"], "active")
        self.assertTrue(active["activation"]["active_at_export"])
        self.assertEqual(active["activation"]["privileges"], ["PRIV-FM"])
        self.assertNotIn("PRIV-IM", active["activation"]["privileges"])
        self.assertEqual(active["monitored_conditions"], [])

    def test_absent_effective_date_uses_decision_date_and_one_year_inclusive_cycle(self):
        approval = self.decision()
        self.assertTrue(approval["admitted"], approval["failures"])
        result = self.project(approval, as_of="2026-04-10")
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "active")
        self.assertEqual(result["activation"]["effective_date"], "2026-04-10")
        self.assertEqual(result["activation"]["cycle_end"], "2027-04-09")
        self.assertTrue(self.project(approval, as_of="2027-04-09")["activation"]["active_at_export"])

    def test_explicit_condition_dates_and_general_wa_expiry_are_both_retained(self):
        self.assessed["licensure"]["wa"] = {"credentialnumber": "SYNTHETIC-WA-001", "expirationdate": "2026-11-30"}
        approval = self.decision(outcome="approved-with-conditions", reason="Synthetic recorded monitoring requirements",
                                 conditions=["Reverify Washington licence — due 2026-11-01", "Obtain documented concurrence — due 2026-06-30"])
        self.assertTrue(approval["admitted"], approval["failures"])
        original = deepcopy((self.app, self.assessed, approval))
        result = self.project(approval)
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "active-with-conditions")
        self.assertEqual({item["due"] for item in result["monitored_conditions"]}, {"2026-06-30", "2026-11-01", "2026-11-30"})
        expiry = next(item for item in result["monitored_conditions"] if item["due"] == "2026-11-30")
        self.assertIn("SYNTHETIC-WA-001", expiry["condition"])
        self.assertEqual(result["action_queue"], [])
        self.assertEqual((self.app, self.assessed, approval), original)

    def test_due_condition_creates_owned_clinical_review_without_invented_suspension(self):
        approval = self.decision(outcome="approved-with-conditions", reason="Synthetic monitoring requirement",
                                 conditions=["Obtain documented concurrence — due 2026-06-30"])
        self.assertTrue(approval["admitted"], approval["failures"])
        for as_of in ["2026-06-30", "2026-07-01"]:
            with self.subTest(as_of=as_of):
                result = self.project(approval, as_of=as_of)
                self.assertEqual(result["status"], "active-with-conditions")
                self.assertTrue(result["activation"]["active_at_export"])
                self.assertEqual(len(result["action_queue"]), 1)
                self.assertEqual(result["action_queue"][0]["owner"], "Clinical Director")
                self.assertEqual(result["action_queue"][0]["due"], "2026-06-30")
                self.assertIn("Unmet monitored condition", result["action_queue"][0]["item"])
                self.assertEqual(len(result["monitored_conditions"]), 1)

    def test_refused_approval_never_activates_or_creates_monitoring_conditions(self):
        approval = self.decision(signatory="Unlisted person", outcome="approved-with-conditions", reason="Synthetic condition",
                                 conditions=["Obtain documented concurrence — due 2026-06-30"])
        self.assertFalse(approval["admitted"])
        result = self.project(approval)
        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "decision-inadmissible")
        self.assertIsNone(result["approval_decision_id"])
        self.assertIsNone(result["activation"])
        self.assertEqual(result["monitored_conditions"], [])
        self.assertEqual(result["action_queue"][0]["owner"], "Medical Services Professional")

    def test_explicit_superseding_approval_replaces_effective_privilege_grant(self):
        first = self.decision()
        replacement = self.decision(decision_id="SYNTHETIC-GB-002", when="2026-04-15", privileges="PRIV-IM",
                                    supersedes=first["fields"]["decision_id"], prior=[self.recommendation, first])
        self.assertTrue(replacement["admitted"], replacement["failures"])
        result = self.project(replacement, prior=[first])
        self.assertEqual(result["approval_decision_id"], "SYNTHETIC-GB-002")
        self.assertEqual(result["activation"]["privileges"], ["PRIV-IM"])
        self.assertEqual(result["activation"]["effective_date"], "2026-04-15")
        self.assertEqual(result["activation"]["cycle_end"], "2027-04-14")
        self.assertEqual([row["decision_id"] for row in result["decisions"]], ["SYNTHETIC-MEC-001", "SYNTHETIC-GB-001", "SYNTHETIC-GB-002"])

    def test_explicit_superseding_nonapproval_does_not_retain_old_authorization(self):
        first = self.decision(outcome="approved-with-conditions", reason="Synthetic monitoring requirement",
                              conditions=["Obtain documented concurrence — due 2026-06-30"])
        self.assertTrue(first["admitted"], first["failures"])
        for outcome, status in [("denied", "denied"), ("deferred-pending-information", "deferred")]:
            with self.subTest(outcome=outcome):
                replacement = self.decision(decision_id="SYNTHETIC-GB-002", when="2026-04-15", outcome=outcome,
                                            reason="Synthetic superseding human outcome", privileges="",
                                            supersedes=first["fields"]["decision_id"], prior=[self.recommendation, first])
                self.assertTrue(replacement["admitted"], replacement["failures"])
                result = self.project(replacement, prior=[first])
                self.assertEqual(result["status"], status)
                self.assertIsNone(result["approval_decision_id"])
                self.assertIsNone(result["activation"])
                self.assertEqual(result["monitored_conditions"], [])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

request-date condition. This helper assesses facts only. Its caller must still
check source authority, receipt dates, reply outcome, dates and open disputes.

import re


def referees_for_revision(app: dict, tables: dict, as_of: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Return retained named-referee rows applicable to this revision/clock.

    Export-note table description and join rule 1 distinguish peers named on an
    application or supplied later from the four tables restated per revision.
    Keep this application's highest applicable revision per referee_id, including
    earlier IDs when a later referee supplements them. A recorded first request
    after ``as_of`` is future evidence and excluded; blank dates start no clock.
    For same-ID/same-revision updates the last supplied row wins. Returned rows
    are copies with their original revisions intact. This does not establish
    peer eligibility, reply receipt or provenance; callers assess those anew.
    """
    latest = {}
    revision = int(app["revision"])
    for row in tables.get("peer-referees", []):
        if row.get("application_id") != app["application_id"] or int(row["revision"]) > revision:
            continue
        if row.get("first_request_date") and row["first_request_date"] > as_of:
            continue
        referee_id = row["referee_id"]
        if referee_id not in latest or int(row["revision"]) >= int(latest[referee_id]["revision"]):
            latest[referee_id] = row
    return [dict(row) for row in latest.values()]


def _normal(value):
    return " ".join(str(value or "").casefold().split())


def _role_facts(reply):
    facts = []
    if reply.get("verified_role"):
        facts.append(("verified_role", reply["verified_role"]))
    credential = reply.get("verified_credential", "")
    match = re.fullmatch(r"(Employment|Affiliation|Degree|Residency|Fellowship|Internship)\s*[—–-]\s*(.+)", credential, re.IGNORECASE)
    if match:
        kind, value = match.groups()
        if kind.casefold() in {"residency", "fellowship", "internship"}:
            if not _normal(value).endswith(kind.casefold()):
                value += " " + kind
        facts.append(("verified_credential", value))
    return facts


def verified_role(reply: dict) -> str | None:
    """Return one unambiguous normalized role from structured reply evidence.

    Case and whitespace are normalized. ``Degree — Doctor of Medicine`` yields
    ``doctor of medicine``; ``Residency — Family Medicine`` yields
    ``family medicine residency`` (likewise fellowship/internship). Employment
    and affiliation prefixes are removed. Explicit ``verified_role`` is also
    considered; if it contradicts the credential label, return None. Unlabelled
    free text and notes yield no inferred role. This is a fact extraction helper,
    not source acceptance, currency or completeness approval.
    """
    values = {_normal(value) for _, value in _role_facts(reply)}
    return values.pop() if len(values) == 1 else None


def assess_revision(entry: dict, histories: list[dict], reply: dict) -> dict:
    """Return ``changed_fields``, ``missing_facts`` and ``conflicts``.

    ``entry`` is one current declared-history row. ``histories`` may contain
    multiple applications/revisions; only this application/entry's strictly
    lower revisions are compared. Each field uses its most recent differing
    prior value, so a later contact-only revision cannot hide an unsupported
    earlier role change. No predecessor means no revision changes to reconcile
    (the caller still verifies the original entry).

    ``changed_fields`` maps each changed nonidentity field to previous/current
    raw values, their revision numbers and an ``evidence`` list. Each evidence
    item records a reply field, extracted value and source reference.
    ``missing_facts`` and ``conflicts`` are lists of dictionaries containing
    field, declared value, reason and source_refs; conflicts also retain the
    verified value. Empty lists mean no additional revision-specific hold,
    never that the entire entry or reply has been verified.

    Contact changes are traced without invalidating credential facts. Dates
    are traced for the caller's existing date comparison. Changed organization,
    role, supervisor and other substantive fields need corresponding evidence.
    Explicit supplemental ``verified_role``/``verified_supervisor`` fields are
    supported. Clear credential labels can establish role; notes are preserved
    by the caller and are never mined for authority or guessed facts here.
    Request/receipt dates do not decide whether a fact matches a declaration.

             if row.get("application_id") == entry.get("application_id")
             and row.get("entry_id") == entry.get("entry_id")
             and int(row["revision"]) < revision]

    if not prior:

    reply_ref = "verification-replies.csv#" + reply.get("reply_id", "<unidentified>")

                    and _normal(attester) and _normal(attester) in _normal(reply.get("received_from", ""))):
                facts.append(("attester_organization", attester))
        else:
            key = "verified_" + field
            if reply.get(key) not in (None, ""):
                facts.append((key, reply[key]))
        change["evidence"] = [{"field": key, "value": value, "source_ref": reply_ref} for key, value in facts]

                "reason": "Retained reply does not establish the revised material fact",
                "source_refs": refs})
        for key, value in facts:
            if _normal(value) != _normal(current):
                result["conflicts"].append({"field": field, "declared": current,
                    "verified": value, "reason": f"Revised declaration differs from reply field {key}",
                    "source_refs": refs})
    return result

"""Record the supplied Clinical Director dispositions without making judgments.

Callers provide documents already limited to the relevant assessment date. A
valid disposition is retained even when its specifically referenced evidence
is missing; authority and evidence sufficiency are separate facts.
"""

from datetime import date
import re

from .documents import document_conflicts, period
from .policy import normalized, person


def _valid_date(value):
    try:
        return bool(re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", value)) and bool(date.fromisoformat(value))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False


def _sentences(text):
    # Only the narrative is scanned for explicit dispositions. Labelled fields
    # and headings cannot supply an instruction such as discontinuation.
    prose = "\n".join(line for line in text.splitlines() if not line.startswith(("#", "**")))
    return [sentence.strip() for sentence in re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+|\n+", prose) if sentence.strip()]


def _authority(doc, app, reg):
    fields, index, reasons = doc["fields"], doc.get("index", {}), []
    for name in ("date", "application", "applicant", "recorded_by"):
        if not fields.get(name):
            reasons.append("Missing required disposition field: " + name)
    if index.get("application_id") != app["application_id"]:
        reasons.append("Correspondence application does not match assessed application")
    if not index.get("date"):
        reasons.append("Correspondence date is missing")
    else:
        reasons.extend(document_conflicts(doc, app))
    when = fields.get("date", "")
    if not _valid_date(when):
        reasons.append("Disposition date is not a valid recorded ISO date")
    role = next((item for item in reg["roles"] if item["role"] == "Clinical Director"), None)
    author = re.fullmatch(r"(.+),\s*Clinical Director", fields.get("recorded_by", ""), re.IGNORECASE)
    if role is None or author is None or person(author[1]) != person(role["name"]):
        reasons.append("Recorded by is not the rostered Clinical Director in that role")
    elif not _valid_date(when) or ((role.get("start") and when < role["start"]) or (role.get("end") and when > role["end"])):
        reasons.append("Clinical Director did not hold the role on the recorded disposition date")
    # The four supplied records use a standalone name and role as their footer.
    # A label claiming authorship alone is not the signed-record evidence.
    footer = [line.strip() for line in doc["text"].splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if (role is None or len(footer) < 2 or normalized(footer[-1]) != "clinical director"
            or person(footer[-2]) != person(role["name"])):
        reasons.append("Disposition lacks the rostered Clinical Director's name/role signature footer")
    return reasons


def _gap_evidence(app, doc, documents, gap, required_dates):
    qualifying = []
    expected_names = {person(" ".join([app["first_name"], app["last_name"]])),
                      person(" ".join([app["first_name"], app["middle_name"], app["last_name"]]))}
    for explanation in documents:
        index, fields = explanation.get("index", {}), explanation["fields"]
        when = index.get("date", "")
        explained = period(explanation)
        if (index.get("application_id") != app["application_id"] or index.get("direction") != "inbound"
                or not _valid_date(when) or when > doc["fields"].get("date", "")
                or explained is None or not all(_valid_date(value) for value in explained)
                or explained[0] > gap[0] or explained[1] < gap[1]
                or person(fields.get("from", "")) not in expected_names
                or document_conflicts(explanation, app)):
            continue
        if not required_dates or when in required_dates:
            qualifying.append(explanation)
    missing = [when for when in required_dates if not any(item["index"]["date"] == when for item in qualifying)]
    reasons = ["Specifically referenced applicant explanation missing or not qualifying: " + when for when in missing]
    if not required_dates and not qualifying:
        reasons.append("No qualifying applicant explanation covers the full disposed gap")
    return [item["path"] for item in qualifying], missing, reasons


def clinical_dispositions(app, docs, reg):
    """Return source records, authority checks, and narrowly explicit tags.

    `authorized` concerns roster/signature/identity/date only. `gap_cleared`
    additionally requires the recorded satisfactory judgment and every named
    explanation covering the entire disposed period. No tag verifies unrelated
    evidence, changes declarations, recommends appointment, or grants privileges.
    """
    records = []
    for doc in docs:
        title = doc.get("title", "")
        if not re.match(r"^Clinical Director['’]s disposition\b", title, re.IGNORECASE):
            continue
        if (doc.get("index", {}).get("application_id") != app["application_id"]
                and doc["fields"].get("application") != app["application_id"]):
            continue
        reasons = _authority(doc, app, reg)
        authorized = not reasons
        sentences = _sentences(doc["text"])
        terminal = any(re.match(r"^Discontinue the application\b", sentence, re.IGNORECASE) for sentence in sentences)
        amendment = any(re.match(r"^Offer the applicant the opportunity to amend the privilege request\b", sentence, re.IGNORECASE) for sentence in sentences)

"""Explicitly synthetic named satisfaction records, never inferred completion."""

from copy import deepcopy
import unittest

from credentialing.conditions import condition_satisfaction
from credentialing.documents import indexed_documents
from test_connected_workflow import APP, ConnectedWorkflowTests


class ConditionSatisfactionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        ConnectedWorkflowTests.setUpClass()
        cls.workflow = ConnectedWorkflowTests()
        cls.reg = cls.workflow.reg

    def setUp(self):
        self.batch = self.workflow.fixture()
        self.batch["export_date"] = "2026-06-30"
        self.batch["tables"]["licence-lookup-wa"][0]["expirationdate"] = "2026-11-30"
        self.workflow.decisions(self.batch, conditional=True)
        self.app = self.batch["tables"]["applications"][0]
        self.approval = indexed_documents(self.batch)[-1]["fields"]
        self.conditions = [{"condition": "Reverify Washington licence — due 2026-11-01", "due": "2026-11-01"},
                           {"condition": "Obtain documented concurrence — due 2026-06-30", "due": "2026-06-30"}]

    def record(self, *, condition=None, role="Clinical Director", when="2026-06-30", changes=None, signed=True):
        author = next(row for row in self.reg["roles"] if row["role"] == role)
        condition = condition or self.conditions[1]
        fields = {"Approval decision ID": "SYN-GB", "Condition": condition["condition"], "Due": condition["due"],
                  "Date": when, "Outcome": "satisfied", "Recorded by": author["name"], "Role": role}
        fields.update(changes or {})
        footer = f"Signed: {author['name']}, {role}, {when}." if signed else "Recorded for review."
        self.workflow.document(self.batch, "satisfaction", "Condition satisfaction", fields, when, footer)
        return indexed_documents(self.batch)[-1]

    def evaluate(self, doc):
        records = condition_satisfaction(self.app, self.approval, self.conditions, [doc], self.reg, self.batch["export_date"])
        self.assertEqual(len(records), 1)
        return records[0]

    def test_signed_clinical_record_matches_only_exact_named_condition(self):
        doc = self.record()
        original = deepcopy((self.app, self.approval, self.conditions, doc))
        record = self.evaluate(doc)
        self.assertTrue(record["valid"], record["failures"])
        self.assertTrue(record["satisfied"])
        self.assertEqual(record["matched_condition"], self.conditions[1])
        self.assertEqual(record["source"], "synthetic/satisfaction.md")
        self.assertEqual(record["text"], doc["text"])
        self.assertEqual((self.app, self.approval, self.conditions, doc), original)

    def test_msp_can_record_routine_wa_reverification_in_both_supported_formats(self):
        expiry = {"condition": "Reverify Washington licence SYN-WA before expiry; recorded due date is expiry under P Check 1.", "due": "2026-11-30"}
        self.conditions.append(expiry)
        for condition in (self.conditions[0], expiry):
            with self.subTest(condition=condition):
                record = self.evaluate(self.record(condition=condition, role="Medical Services Professional"))
                self.assertTrue(record["satisfied"], record["failures"])
                self.assertEqual(record["matched_condition"], condition)

    def test_unmatched_incomplete_future_unsigned_and_unrecognized_records_are_retained(self):
        cases = [
            {"changes": {"Approval decision ID": "ANOTHER-APPROVAL"}},
            {"changes": {"Revision": "2"}},
            {"changes": {"Application": "ANOTHER-APPLICATION"}},
            {"changes": {"Condition": "All conditions complete"}},
            {"changes": {"Due": "2026-07-01"}},
            {"changes": {"Outcome": "complete"}},
            {"changes": {"Recorded by": "Unlisted Person"}},
            {"changes": {"Date": "2026-06-29"}},
            {"when": "2026-04-09"},
            {"when": "2026-07-01"},
            {"signed": False},
        ]
        for kwargs in cases:
            with self.subTest(kwargs=kwargs):
                record = self.evaluate(self.record(**kwargs))
                self.assertFalse(record["valid"])
                self.assertFalse(record["satisfied"])
                self.assertTrue(record["failures"])
                self.assertEqual(record["source"], "synthetic/satisfaction.md")

    def test_msp_nonroutine_record_remains_for_review_as_parser_limitation(self):
        record = self.evaluate(self.record(role="Medical Services Professional"))
        self.assertFalse(record["satisfied"])
        self.assertTrue(any("parser limitation" in failure for failure in record["failures"]))
        self.assertEqual(record["matched_condition"], self.conditions[1])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
